## Why oMLX?

- **Persistent KV cache** - KV cache survives across requests, even when context changes mid-conversation. All past context stays cached and reusable, making local LLMs practical for real coding work.
- **Two-tier memory** - Hot models stay in unified memory; cold models live on SSD. Swap in/out automatically.
- **Context limits** - Per-model context cap (e.g. 32K) so a long session can't blow up memory.
- **Menu bar control** - Start/stop, swap, and monitor from the menu bar. No terminal
